name: manual_96ce16
claim: Capability-band comparisons must report observed pass deltas separately from collection changes. Compare exact collected test IDs before attributing a delta to added or absent tests; state only counts measured from those IDs, and do not infer a negative seam-absent count by arithmetic.

decisions.notes: Supersedes the unverified negative-count wording while retaining the valid requirement to compare collected test IDs; counts must be attributed only when observed.

rationale: Supersedes the unverified negative-count wording while retaining the valid requirement to compare collected test IDs; counts must be attributed only when observed.
